steps.en: Local-vehicle notices waiting for owner lookup are picked for the agency
steps.id: Notice kendaraan lokal yang menunggu data pemilik dipilih untuk dikirim ke agency

steps.en: Owner details from the agency are saved on the notice
steps.id: Detail pemilik dari agency disimpan ke notice
steps.why_en: Open defects show many notices moved on without owner details ever being saved.
steps.why_id: Defect yang masih terbuka menunjukkan banyak notice lanjut tanpa detail pemilik tersimpan.

steps.en: Notices with no owner found are suspended and retried
steps.id: Notice tanpa data pemilik ditangguhkan lalu dicoba lagi
steps.why_en: The retry loop is reported unreliable; some notices are not resent for weeks.
steps.why_id: Siklus coba ulang dilaporkan tidak andal; sebagian notice tidak dikirim ulang berminggu-minggu.

steps.en: The owner's ID type is worked out and saved
steps.id: Jenis ID pemilik ditentukan dan disimpan
